visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair and a black Jurassic Park t-shirt stands before a grey tiled wall. Black ink is splattered across his face and neck. He looks directly at the camera with a neutral expression under bright indoor lighting. (2) A computer-generated Dilophosaurus dinosaur appears close-up, moving its head. It has a distinctive double crest on its head and colored patterns on its skin. The background is blurred, focusing on the creature's sharp eyes and reptilian texture. (3) The man flinches as more black liquid is sprayed directly onto his face and eyes. A circular logo with Chinese text appears in the center of the frame against the background of the man's ink-covered face. (4) The scene shifts to a kitchen where the man is peeling a hard-boiled egg. The background is filled with various colorful magnets and small items on a refrigerator. He is focused on his hands, which hold the egg carefully. (5) A CG Pteranodon dinosaur is shown screeching loudly with its mouth open, positioned over a nest of large dinosaur eggs. The environment looks like a rocky cave with dim, natural lighting and some dry straw on the ground. (6) The man eats the boiled egg while looking upwards with a slightly startled or thoughtful expression. The same circular logo with the Jurassic Park dinosaur silhouette and Chinese text reappears over the shot as he chews. (7) In a dimly lit bathroom, the man with wet hair is suddenly splashed with a large amount of water. He is wearing the same black t-shirt and reacts to the cold water by blinking and leaning back slightly. (8) A large CG Spinosaurus-like dinosaur rises from a body of water at dusk. The sky is a deep purple and orange. The dinosaur roars as water cascades off its sail and snout, creating a dramatic, cinematic scene. (9) The man is shown underwater, appearing as a merman with green and gold scales covering his chest. He looks calmly at the camera while bubbles float around him. The lighting is diffused and blueish, typical of a deep-sea setting. (10) A massive CG Mosasaurus swims through dark water towards the viewer with its jaws open. Bubbles and debris float in the water around it. The circular logo appears one last time over the underwater scene.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, wet splashing sound occurs as liquid hits a surface. This is accompanied by a very high-pitched, metallic dinosaur screech that fluctuates in frequency. There is no background music, only the raw, transient sound of the impact and a brief silence following the screech. (2) A short snippet of a grand orchestral theme begins, featuring high-energy strings and brass instruments. The tempo is moderate, around 110 BPM, conveying a sense of epic adventure. The audio is studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio and bright spectral centroid, indicating professional production. (3) The sound of an eggshell cracking is heard, characterized by a crisp, high-frequency percussive snap followed by the rustling of shell fragments. A different, harsher dinosaur screech enters the mix, sounding like a predatory bird with a wide frequency bandwidth and aggressive tonality. (4) The orchestral adventure theme returns briefly, synchronized with a visual transition. The music is dominated by a majestic brass melody in a major mode. The recording quality is professional and compressed for a broadcast-ready social media edit style, ensuring clarity across the frequency spectrum. (5) A loud, roaring sound with heavy low-frequency content and splashing water textures dominates the audio track. The roar has a rough, strained vocal quality typical of a large animal. The ambient noise floor shifts to an outdoor, wet environment with splashing water layers. (6) The grand orchestral motif plays again, providing a triumphant musical punctuation. The beat strength is moderate, and the harmonic tension is low, resolving into a familiar melodic phrase. The mix is clear with no technical distortion or clipping artifacts, maintaining high fidelity. (7) A sudden transition to a pop song occurs, featuring a rhythmic electronic beat and a female vocal singing in English. The tempo is fast, approximately 125 BPM. This is layered with the sound of bubbling water and underwater muffled acoustics, creating a high-arousal texture. (8) A deep, resonant underwater growl or rumble is heard, followed by a final repetition of the orchestral adventure theme. The theme swells in volume before a hard cut to silence. The production is a highly fragmented montage with rapid-fire editing between musical and SFX elements.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Action/Parallel -> Climax -> Brand Identity
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous and entertaining tribute to the Jurassic World franchise by paralleling mundane real-life situations (getting messy, eating an egg, taking a bath) with cinematic dinosaur encounters. The video uses creative editing and special effects to position the creator within the Jurassic universe.
